Hello everyone!
Thank you for visiting my page.

The adult comics uploaded to E-Hentai are a few weeks/months behind my Patreon, meaning Patreon has the most recent chapters. I upload atleast 4-5 chapters a month if you're interested in joining the Patreon.
If interested, please find me here: https://www.patreon.com/ARubberDucky or on https://subscribestar.adult/arubberducky

I always upload all of the stories I make for the public to see, please do not feel the need subscribe, but any support is really appreciated! I work about 20-30 hours a week on the stories, so thanks for the support if you do ❤❤❤

To celebrate the new CD101 cover, I've decided to giveaway some memberships on my Patreon so you can view the chapters as early as possible!
